scope: Every artifact, state type, finite execution, canonical event trace and compiler-private byte predicate; ownership may close over the supported invocation/frame environment.
claims: Erased events are positive-size ordinary reads or writes whose every addressed byte belongs to the supplied private region.

Retained events equal their raw originals, including address, size, access kind, bytes and initialization flag. Helpers, atomic effects, exclusive/order effects, faults and empty accesses remain observable.
Each projected block contains a physical raw-proof execution with identical physical endpoints and its exact ordered projected trace.
Any finite sequence of projected blocks lifts to a physical proof execution; projection preserves the order of every retained event.
Verifier-checked raw effects imply checked projected effects through retained-event identity. The physical verifier soundness assumption supplies this property directly.

generic_artifact_effects_checked composes a universal native-to-projected-proof law, actual raw-proof verifier soundness/admitted entry, and full executed/validated Artifact binding to cover every native effect.

validation.dependency_scope: Generic Composition and canonical Memory/Event types supply the complete import scope.

premises: The generic compiler/layout invariant supplies byte ownership and public/private separation for the actual invocation/frame environment. Artifact metadata fixes the layout and the bound entry relation fixes its invocation parameters.
The native-to-projected-proof validation law is quantified over all artifacts and carries architectural state, control and ordered effects.
Verifier soundness is assumed for actual accepted raw-proof executions and their admitted entry. Complete Artifact equality binds both code images, entry, ABI and specialization/layout metadata.
completion_path: Prove spill insertion/reload/control preservation and private-frame ownership for the actual generic compiler/layout transformation, then use the projection theorem as its verifier-soundness adapter.
Combine V token/definedness laws, actual compiler-output preservation, relocation layout and remaining map/helper/tail-call transformations through Composition.lean.
trusted: Actual accepted-proof verifier soundness and supported physical entry/kernel binding provenance.
